newsitem.title: MEXICO: Moderna chairman recovering after fall.
newsitem.headline: Moderna chairman recovering after fall.

text.p: Alfonso Romo, the chairman of Empresas La Moderna, is recovering in a German hospital after falling from a horse, the company said Tuesday.
Romo, a former Olympic equestrian, underwent a leg operation of almost two hours after falling in a training session before a jumping competition in Wiesbaden, Moderna spokesman Mateo Mazal said.

"He is fine, he is recovering normally after the operation. Later today or tomorrow his doctor will give instructions concerning his transfer to Monterrey," Mazal said. Moderna, a conglomerate, is based in the northern industrial city.
"It is the natural risk of any sport," Mazal said, adding the Sunday accident was the worst Romo had suffered in his riding career.
